name: connections
summary: How pipes, cables and chutes connect, from the game's own ends and networks: one thing's ends, or a network's members (40 per page) with filters and a summary. Read only.

help.text: Two forms. reference_id: a pipe, cable, chute or device's ends. network_id with kind (pipe, cable or chute): the network's members, pieces first then devices, paged. A big network reads best with an area and fields ["reference_id", "prefab_name"] or omit ["members.position"].
help.keys: thing {reference_id, prefab_name, display_name}, position {x, y, z}, rotation {facing, up, euler}, own_network {kind, id}, ends [{index, type, type_name, role, role_name, position, network, connected}], count, network {kind, id}, summary, members [{reference_id, prefab_name, display_name, member, position, open_ends}], structure_count, device_count, offset, limit, total, has_more, resolved_networks.

ends.text: thing, position, rotation {facing, up, euler} (as place_structure takes it; facing and up null off the grid's axes), own_network ({kind, id} of a piece, else null) and ends [{index, type (Pipe, PipeLiquid, Power, Data, PowerAndData, Chute, Elevator, LandingPad, LaunchPad, RoboticArmRail), type_name, role (None, Input, Input2, Output, Output2, Waste), role_name, position, network ({kind, id}: a piece's own at every end; for a device the network attached there, null when none), connected (everything attached at that end)}]. Network ids come from ends[].network.id.

network.summary: The network form, its filters and summary.
network.text: members [{reference_id, prefab_name, display_name, member, position}] with count, structure_count, device_count, paging, network {kind, id} and summary. Filters, applied before paging (total counts the members kept): prefab_contains, open_ends_only (each member then lists open_ends), and an area: min and max (a box) or near with radius_m. Pipe summary: content, volume_l, pressure_kpa, temperature_k, total_mol, liquid_volume_l, gases (null on a multiplayer client). Cable summary, from the last power tick as the Cable Analyser shows it: required_w, potential_w, actual_w, shortfall_w, lowest_cable_max_w, lowest_fuse_break_w, overloaded, fuse_overloaded, cable_count, fuse_count. Chute summary: member_count.

refusals.text: not_connectable: not a pipe, cable, chute or device, so it has no connection ends. thing_not_found and network_not_found: nothing has that id.

reference_id.description: A pipe, cable, chute or device: its ends.
A device or piece on the network.

network_id.description: A network (with kind) or a handle on it: its members (see networks).

kind.description: The kind of network_id: pipe, cable or chute.

prefab_contains.description: Network form: only members whose prefab name holds this, any case.

open_ends_only.description: Network form: only members with an end nothing is attached at. Default false.

min.description: Network form: a box corner, [x, y, z] in metres; with max.

max.description: Network form: the other box corner.

near.description: Network form: a point, [x, y, z] in metres; with radius_m.

radius_m.description: Network form: with near, up to 1000.

limit.description: Network form: members per page; default 40.

offset.description: Network form: members to skip (see paging).

x-paging.order: network form only: the network's pieces as the game lists them (its structure list), then its devices, each thing once
